ghi_chu: Con so do bang man-that-lib.mjs TRUOC KHI SUA (git show HEAD) va SAU KHI SUA, tren CUNG du lieu cua may nay, ngay 08/09 — hai luot ra y het. Day la neo cua AC-14(2): thu vien sua xong khong duoc doi so do cua ho so da ky. So trong evidence-report.md da ky la 42/118, do tren may cu voi du lieu khac (ty gia, ten workspace), nen khong phai neo hop le giua hai may.
